verdictSummary: The stale date audit is caused by exactly five changed dated items, none of which changes chronology. Four honor claims (claim-322/330/336/342) migrated the retired receptionType label posthumous to the sole valid later-reception label retrospective, and the active-date hint hints-p001 was reformatted by the native existing-year normalizer (209–174 BC to BC 209–BC 174). Source bytes are unchanged. All other 644 item checks, 153 person checks and 296 reviewed units remain valid against byte-identical packet items and may be reused through native recording. The owner proposal is approved with amendments: its scope omitted hints-p001 and cited the wrong migration commit. No real contradiction blocks closure. Two definite English omissions in the cited units are recorded separately as supplemental repairs and do not block the date closure.

holdAssessment: No concrete source contradiction, attribution conflict or false-merge risk was found in the changed items or their direct dependencies. The supplemental English repairs below are definite omissions in the idiomatic field of the cited units. They do not alter Chinese evidence or chronology and are not holds on the date closure.

supplementalEnglishRepairs.before: Yanping 1: Xianbei raided Yuyang again; Zhang Xian chased with hundreds of men.
supplementalEnglishRepairs.after: Yanping 1: The Xianbei raided Yuyang again, and Administrator Zhang Xian led several hundred men beyond the frontier in pursuit.
supplementalEnglishRepairs.reason: The Chinese 太守張顯率數百人出塞追之 says that Administrator Zhang Xian led several hundred men beyond the frontier in pursuit. The idiomatic text drops the office 太守 and the proposition 出塞 (pursuit beyond the frontier), and weakens 數百人 to "hundreds". The literal field already has these. "Administrator" follows the majority idiomatic rendering of 太守 in this chapter and the extraction descriptor for p067. 復 is kept as "again".
supplementalEnglishRepairs.repeatedUses: The English string appears only in this unit. The extraction item texts for claims 322/330/336/342 already match the Chinese.

supplementalEnglishRepairs.before: Empress Dowager Deng rewarded Zhang Xian with six hundred thousand cash and two kinsmen as court gentlemen; Yan Shou, Wei Fu, and Xu Xian each got one hundred thousand cash and a son appointed gentleman.
supplementalEnglishRepairs.after: Empress Dowager Deng issued a rescript praising them: Zhang Xian was granted six hundred thousand cash and two members of his household were made court gentlemen; Yan Shou, Wei Fu, and Xu Xian each received one hundred thousand cash, and one son of each was made a gentleman.
supplementalEnglishRepairs.reason: The Chinese 鄧太后策書褒歎 says that Empress Dowager Deng issued a rescript in praise of them. The idiomatic text omits the rescript and its praise, reducing the clause to "rewarded". The repair restores it and keeps every amount and appointment. The literal field ("Empress Dowager Deng's rescript praised them") is adequate and unchanged.
supplementalEnglishRepairs.repeatedUses: The English string appears only in this unit. The extraction item texts for claims 322/330/336/342 already match the Chinese.

supplementalEnglishRepairsRouting: Host routes these into the active editorial application with a separate reviewer for worker-authored repairs, kept outside the closed-schema date report. Applying them changes only the en field of s3329 and s3334; zh, literal and blockIndex stay the same. The computed post-repair packet sourceHash is sha256:1297314962546f997fc7cfc771918a129e8722c3514e5613e92486240976d0ac. If they are applied before the date closure (batch repairs before downstream audits), compose the closure against the post-repair source and extraction hashes. The chronology conclusions here carry over unchanged provided the native packet diff shows only those two en values (plus any appended translationRepairs entries for them). Otherwise, reconcile them later as an English-only stale generation.
